content: That one-by-one tip is excellent and should be incorporated into the instructions for this step.

If you replace the zip ties one by one , instead of cutting them all at the beginning, the LED cable stays in place and you don't have to deal with it again. Just be sure to check out the next step first so the new cable is in the right place.

replies.content: Excellent advice! This is how I do these triplet zip ties on the CORE One anytime I have to run a new cable. Works great!
